test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

He felt dejected but the feeling __passed out__ in a minute.
solution:
The correct answer is 'Passed off.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the underlined segment, the phrasal verb ''Passed out'' is incorrect.
 
• The given sentence is talking about **someone who felt dejected but that feeling evaded or dismissed in a minute**.
 
• The phrasal verb ''Passed out'' means **To become unconscious**.
 
• Therefore, the phrasal verb ''Passed off'' should be used in place of the phrasal verb ''Passed out''.
 
• The phrasal verb ''Passed off'' means To** ****evade or lightly dismiss an awkward remark**.**
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct Sentence: *He felt dejected but the feeling **passed off** in a minute*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Passed back means **To give something back to someone with one's hand**.
 
• Passed on means To die**.
